display_long_description:
🔍 Every Passenger Is Hiding Something…

Can you spot the threat before it’s too late?

Step into the role of an airport security officer in a high-stakes VR experience where every decision can stop danger — or let it through.

✈️ Inspect. Detect. Decide.

Passengers line up at your checkpoint — but not all of them are innocent.

Some carry fake identities.
Some hide dangerous items.
Some are nervous for a reason.

👉 It’s your job to find out why.

🛂 Check Documents — Spot the Fake

Compare passports and boarding passes carefully.
One small mismatch could reveal a fraudulent traveler.

🔎 Scan Passengers — Find Hidden Threats

Use advanced body scanners to uncover concealed weapons and illegal items.
Stay sharp — not everything is obvious.

💼 Inspect Luggage — Nothing Is Safe

Open bags and examine every item.
Suspicious objects can be hidden in plain sight.

❤️ Monitor Vitals — Detect the Risk

Check passenger health indicators to identify hidden medical dangers or infections.

✅ Approve… or Stop Them

Make the final call:

✔ Allow safe passengers through
❌ Stop suspicious individuals
🚨 Prevent threats before it’s too late

⚠️ One Mistake Changes Everything

Let the wrong passenger through…
And the consequences are on you.

👮 Are You Ready to Take Control?

Stay alert. Trust your instincts.
Protect the airport at all costs.
